newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: PT says not responsible for press report.
newsitem.headline: PT says not responsible for press report.

text.p: Portugal Telecom said it was not responsible for a report in Publico newspaper which said it would announce a 1996 profit of 55 billion escudos.
"The closing of PT's accounts is under way, and so any comment on the 1996 results is not the responsibility of this company," a statement said.
"PT will announce its 1996 results in mid-March," it added.
Publico said it had learned that PT would announce a 1996 profit of 55 billion escudos, up from 36.3 billion in 1995.
PT shares rose today to an all-time high on the Lisbon bourse of 6,350 escudos on Thursday before easing to 6,300, up 20, in volume of 239,358 shares, at 1224 GMT.
Dealers said euphoria over the telecommunications sector and a buy recommendation for PT stock by SBC Warburg were reasons for the surge in PT shares.
